reference.title: Value source mechanism
reference.shortdesc: Output and prioritized value descriptors support the BACnet value source mechanism as described in clause 19.5 of the standard. This mechanism identifies the source of the BACnet object's Present Value.

section.p: When there is a change in the input slot of a writable point, the following updates occur:

li.p: The corresponding Value Source Array element is updated with information about the device that made the change.
The corresponding Command Time Array element is updated with the current time of the change.
If the input slot change triggers changes to the point's output slot, point's active level, or the value source, the Last Command Time is updated to reflect this change.

section.p: If the change originates from a remote device, and the station's device registry recognizes the device ID based on the property write's source address, that device ID is entered in the Value Source Array. If the device ID is not recognized, the source address itself is entered instead.

Only the device that wrote to the Present Value can update the value source device information. This update may include its device ID and an optional object ID. does not currently send any additional value source device information when writing to the Present Value property of other BACnet devices.

In scenarios where the input slot change comes from a local link or user interface (UI), the local device ID is entered in the Value Source Array. Currently, there is no provision for including additional object ID information when such local input slot changes occur.

The BACnet Current Command Priority property directly relates to the active level of the exported writable point. Notably, this value is set to null when the point's active level is designated as fallback.
The BACnet Value Source property reflects the Value Source Array element that corresponds to the active level of the point, or it displays "none" when the active level indicates fallback.
For supported descriptors, there are additional properties that manage the value source mechanism.

li.p: lastCommandTime: Notes the last time the value, command priority, or value source was changed.
valueSourceArray: This array stores details of the last device (by ID or address) that updated the corresponding input slot of the exported writable point.
commandTimeArray: This array stores timestamps for when the corresponding input slot was last changed.

example.title: Example
example.p: The following progression illustrates how the value source mechanism manages commands from various devices and how these devices can update the value sources.

section.title: Starting state
section.p: Initially, no commands have been written to any input slots.

li.p: currentCommandPriority: It is set to Null, indicating that there is no active command with a defined priority.
valueSource and valueSourceArray elements: All are set to None, meaning there is currently no source providing a value to the system.
lastCommandTime and commandTimeArray: All are unspecified BACnetDateTime values.

ul.li: currentCommandPriority: It changes from Null to 10, indicating that device 2 now has the highest priority command.
valueSource and valueSourceArray element 10: They are updated to the remote device's ID because it is registered in the station's device registry.
lastCommandTime and commandTimeArray element 10: They are updated to capture the timing of this command.

section.title: Value source update from remote device 2

ul.li: Remote device 2 updates the valueSource info with an object ID.
Remote device 3 is prohibited from modifying the valueSourceArray at element 10 since the priority 10 was written by remote device 2.
currentCommandPriority does not change and remains at 10.
valueSource and lastCommandTime remain unchanged because the write to priority 12 does not affect the present value.
valueSourceArray element 12 is set to the remote device address because this remote device is not in the station's device registry.

section.title: Value source update from remote device 3

li.p: Remote device 3 updates the value source info with both its device ID and an object ID.
Remote device 2 cannot modify valueSourceArray element 12.

ul.li: valueSource is updated to valueSourceArray element 12 because the currentCommandPriority is now 12.
valueSourceArray element 10 is updated, but since priority 10 is relinquished, it is not used for the valueSource property.

commandTimeArray element 10 is updated to reflect when the relinquishment was received, while lastCommandTime is updated based on when the present value was changed due to the relinquishment. It is important to note commandTimeArray element 10 and lastCommandTime are not exactly equal.
lastCommandTime is not set to commandTimeArray element 12 when priority 12 was written, but represents when the present value changes.

section.title: Changing priority 6 via local link to in6 on exported control point

ul.li: valueSource and valueSourceArray at element 6 are now updated to the local device ID.
lastCommandTime and commandTimeArray element 6 are also updated.
